findings.text: The requirements ask for shots at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440 in `session-desktop/shots/<width>.png`, but that folder does not exist, so the side-by-side cards at 1920/3440 and the 400 match to the phone version are unverified (requirements.md "Check it").

AISessionDetail.js:83 (the `$work.append` line) sets `work` inside the append callback and reads `work.loaded` right after; if `append` defers the callback, `work` is undefined and the line throws. The error would also stop `work_ready` from firing, leaving the stats bar and Overview empty. Create the SessionWork first, then append it.

The stats bar and cards use hard-coded colours (`#fff`, `#6b7178`, `#f7f7f7`, redefined `--mob-*` values) in SessionOverview.css:95-135 instead of the site's tokens, so they will not follow a theme or dark scheme.

The title scrolls away only inside full-screen mode; in normal mode only the stats bar sticks (SessionOverview.css:98), which may not match "a top that scrolls away" in band E. Say which reading was chosen.

MobileTaskRow.js gains an overridable `href()`; the phone behaviour is unchanged, but this edits a file outside the stated fence (you may import from `sessions/v/mobile/`, not change it), so mention it in the merge.
`sw-` is added to css-scopes.txt as well as `sov-`. SessionWork already ships `sw-` classes, so this is probably a correct catch-up, but it is unrelated to the ask.

The Work tab became "Tasks" and Overview sits before it, with old `?tab=work` and `?tab=conversation` links mapped (AISessionDetail.js:42). This matches the "pick one" instruction. Two `decision` lines are in session.jsonl, but I did not verify that one covers the Work-versus-Overview choice and its alternative.
